boundary: Finite association-scheme support uncertainty, not a continuum position-momentum uncertainty relation.
proof_key: Every central spectral projector P_T has constant diagonal d/40. If x=P_S x=P_T x, then P_S P_T P_S has eigenvalue one, while its trace is s*d/40.
theorem: For any nonzero x supported on s vertices and contained in a W33 spectral subspace of total rank d, s*d >= 40.
